d:
You see the world’s best tennis on court. But what makes everything around it possible? Qasa Alom goes behind the scenes at the Nitto ATP Finals, from the players’ tunnel to the broadcast centre, and meets ATP VP Partnerships Rodolphe Tastet to find out what partnerships give fans beyond the logos.
Along the way, he sees how partners like Nitto are helping make the tournament more sustainable, from electric player transport and compostable napkins to the HVO blend used in the Fan Village generators.
